input.title: 2027 Hobie Cat Getaway Sailboat With Wings
input.descriptionHtml:
Not Arriving for 2026 season. We hope to re-stock in 2027.

Dealer Assembly Included!

Take the party on the water with the Hobie Getaway. When the agenda involves sailing with friends and family, the Hobie Getaway is a sure-fire ticket to multi-hull fun.

Stir in the boat's performance-minded symmetrically shaped hulls, its efficient, mainsail-driven sail plan and its roller-furling jib and you quickly discover a sailing pedigree that leaves party boats stalled out. With the Getaway, there's no worry about impromptu raft-ups, beaching or docking; its impact-resistant, rotomolded polyethylene hull provides years worth of family fun. But most impressive is the Getaways awesome value. Expect great times for a modest price tag.

Specs:

  • Crew: 1-6 (US) 3-4 (EU)
  • Length: 17' / 5.18 m
  • Beam: 7' 8" / 2.34 m
  • Capacity: 1000 lbs/453 kg
  • Weight: 390lbs / 176 kg
  • Draft w/ Rudder Up: 10" / 25.4 cm
  • Mast Length: 25' / 7.62 m
  • Total Sail Area: 180 ft / 17 m
  • Hull Construction: Rotomolded Polyethylene
  • Height From Floor to Bow: 29.5" / 74.93 cm
  • Height From Floor to Stern: 17.5" / 44.45 cm

Mast with Comptip Hobie "Mama Bob" Bora Bora Boomless Main Sail Roller Furling Jib 6:1 Mainsheet Block System Eva Deck Pads Mesh Trampolines EZ-Loc Rudders Front Seating Area Optional Wing Seating
